title: fix(adr-0087): predicate 2 reads a `default` export through its import, and a package name inside a path or URL

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBDFDmSVzwiQ3bKV9WbePMBf)_

Fixes #26324
Fixes #27022

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/` names `runtime-export-retired`, `no-metadata-surface` or the ADR-0087 gate (`git grep` over `skills/`: 0 hits), so neither predicate is taught there

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:ADR-0087 登记门禁的谓词 2 修两处。导出名为 `default` 的退役只看"有没有元数据面 import 了这个默认导出,或以命名空间导入、命名空间再导出、动态 `import()` / `require()` 加载了整个模块",不再按单词扫 `default`;整包退役(`PACKAGE#*`)把路径或 URL 字符串里出现的包名也算作引用，但 `@scope/plugin-x` 仍不算无作用域的 `plugin-x`。
- 为什么改:`default` 是元数据里的普通键(`{ value: 'technology', default: true }`、Zod `.default()`),单词扫描在每棵树上都命中，所以任何 `default` 导出的退役都无法如实申报，卡住了 #26206 的后半(移除 driver-memory 的旧默认导出)。路径/URL 那一处是 D9 原文"包名的任何其他出现，含字符串值"与门禁实际放行之间唯一已知的缺口。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `scripts/` 下一个不发布的门禁脚本。`default` 一侧放宽的范围只限导出名恰为 `default` 的操作数，其他导出名读法不变;路径一侧是收紧(多拒)。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs` 的 `defaultImportReference`(四条线性 import 正则，及 `metadataSurfaceReference` 开头的分流)、`packageReference` 的 `mention` 正则(新增一个排除 `@scope/` 段的负向后顾)、自测里的 DX 电池与 WP-U6–U9。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --self-test`,预期打印 `705 assertions`、退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无，席位落地

## What changes

- **#26324, predicate 2 for an export named `default`.** `metadataSurfaceReference` hands a `default` symbol to a new `defaultImportReference`, which reads the import arm only. A metadata surface reaches a default export through an import that binds it: a default binding (`import x from 'M'`, with named bindings or a namespace beside it, `type` or not) or `default` inside the braces of an `import` / `export … from` clause (`{ default as x }`, `export { default } from 'M'`). The specifier is attributed through the existing `specifierNamesModule`, and comment spans are blanked through the shared `maskComments`, as before. The bare-word arm is not read for `default`, because `default` is an ordinary key in exactly the files predicate 2 reads. Every other export name keeps today's reading, both arms. The shared primitive serves `runtime-interface-only` too, so a `PATH#default` there gets the same reading.
- The import shapes are linear regexes anchored at a statement start. They deliberately do **not** reuse `importSpecifiersFor`'s `[\s\S]*?` clause scan. That scan runs today only on files that already contain the symbol's word, and over every metadata surface it is super-linear in the whitespace runs `maskComments` leaves: the first version of this fix reused it and the real-tree run had not finished after 12 minutes of CPU (one file alone, `packages/spec/src/api/discovery.zod.ts`, took 41 s). The linear version runs the whole real-tree gate in 7 s.
- **Round 2 (contract review 6466959531, two should-fixes).** (1) A `default` operand is also refused by a metadata surface that binds the whole declaring module: a namespace import (`import * as ns from 'M'`, `ns.default` one read away), a namespace re-export (`export * as ns from 'M'`), or a dynamic `import('M')` / `require('M')`. The refusal rests on the binding alone, never on a `.default` read after it, so no member tracking is needed; every other export name already refuses these shapes through its bare-word arm, so this closes the admit gap round 1 opened. Both new readers are linear (statement-anchored, no `[\s\S]*?`). (2) `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` moves from 58 to 59 for the new DX battery.
- **#27022, the `PACKAGE#*` mention regex.** Its negative lookbehind drops `/` from the excluded set, and a second negative lookbehind refuses an `@SCOPE/` segment just before the name (`@[\w.~-]+/`). A `/` may now precede the name, so a path or URL inside a string counts as a `mention`, but not a `/` that closes an `@scope` segment, so an unscoped `plugin-x` still does not match inside `@scope/plugin-x`. The name-boundary rules on both sides are unchanged (`plugin-xy` and `my-plugin-x` are other packages).
- Header comments of `metadataSurfaceReference` and `packageReference` say the same.

## Tests

- New battery `DX (#26324)`, floor 19, and the roster floor `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 58 to 59: DX-G1 (the #26206 shape: a retired `default` export beside a `default: true` field option and a Zod `.default('')`) green, with DX-G1b naming the operand and its declaring entry; DX-G2 (the import quoted only in a comment) green; DX-G3 (another module's default imported) green; DX-R1 (a metadata surface that imports the package's default) red; DX-R2 (`{ default as x }`) red; DX-R3 (`import * as ns`, then `ns.default`) red; DX-R4 (a dynamic `import()`) red; DX-R5 (a `require()`) red; DX-R6 (`export * as ns from`) red; DX-U1 to U3 units (default beside named bindings, a type-only subpath default, a multi-line `export { default } from` after a `;`; named bindings, a `default:` key and a `.default()` call alone are not imports; a non-`default` export name keeps the bare-word arm).
- WP battery floor 55 to 59: WP-U6 (the package name inside a path string is a `mention`, with its line), WP-U7 (inside a URL), WP-U8 (`@scope/plugin-x` is not `plugin-x`, bare, in a path and in a URL), WP-U9 (an unscoped `plugin-x` in a path and a URL is still a mention). WP-G3 (comment only) and WP-U4 (`plugin-xy` is not `plugin-x`) stay green unchanged.
- Self-test: 682 to 705 assertions.

## Acceptance notes

- **The driver-memory measurement (the real shape #26206 blocked on).** A local probe commit on `origin/main` `72629f38` deletes the `export default { … }` block from `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/index.ts` and adds a changeset carrying `runtime-export-retired @objectstack/driver-memory#default` with the line `` - FROM `default` TO `InMemoryDriver`: … ``. The probe was never pushed.

  | Gate | Base | Command | Exit | Verdict |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | `origin/main` copy | `72629f38` | `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` | **1** | predicate 2 false: `examples/app-crm/src/objects/account.object.ts` mentions `default` (`{ label: 'Technology', value: 'technology', default: true }`), the card's reading exactly |
  | this PR (`2e1e09d5`) | `72629f38` | same | **0** | `verified: @objectstack/driver-memory#default (export, packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/index.ts)` |
  | this PR (`2e1e09d5`) | `72629f38` plus one object file `import memoryPlugin from '@objectstack/driver-memory'` | `--base PROBE_BASE` | **1** | predicate 2 false: `probe-host.object.ts` (an object definition) IMPORTS `default` from the module that declares it |
  | this PR, round 2 (`f402e245`) | `9dacccf9` (the same probe on the then-current `origin/main`) | `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main` | **0** | `verified: @objectstack/driver-memory#default (export, packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/index.ts)`: the namespace and dynamic readers find nothing on main's metadata surfaces |

- **Read for `default` on the binding, not on `.default`:** a namespace import, a namespace re-export and a dynamic `import('M')` / `require('M')` of the declaring module refuse on the module alone (round 2). The member spelling `.default` is never read, since it cannot be told from object keys and `.default()` calls; refusing on the binding is the conservative direction.
- `importSpecifiersFor`'s super-linear clause scan is left as it is: its callers gate it on the word being present, so no current run is slow. Noted, not filed.
- The order expected `Clause-②: n/a`; both claims carry `Clause-②: no`, and the body copies the claim. No published accept-set moves (`scripts/**` is not shipped), so `no` is accurate either way.
- No changeset: the root package is private and `scripts/**` is not published. Labelled `skip-changeset`.
- The ADR text needs no change: D9's second 2026-10-27 note already says "any other occurrence of the package name, a string value included", and the `default` reading is the D7 import primitive the note points to.
